title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.0.2
body_markdown:
### Changed

* Notify when the `super-early-bird` plugin repository is still used.

### Fixed

* Several causes of `IndexOutOfBoundsException` when applying a solution of "Open Copilot" to the editor, which was changed in the meantime.
* `NullPointerException` when using GitHub Copilot in Jupyter Notebook files
body_html:
